jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: About Moongig Moongig is a rapidly growing digital health talent platform transforming the way healthcare professionals and employers connect in the Philippines and abroad. By leveraging technology, we provide healthcare workers with a broad range of job opportunities, while enabling hospitals, clinics, and care providers to access the skilled talent they need to deliver exceptional care. Our mission is to expand access, enhance workforce mobility, and support professional growth across the healthcare ecosystem. This role is designed for high ownership and high learning. You will have direct exposure to leadership decision-making and will collaborate closely on execution, prioritization, and technical direction. Our leadership team combines deep healthcare technology operating experience with proven startup scaling capability. You will work directly with Christian Besler, a health-tech veteran with 20+ years experience and degree from Columbia University, and Nathaniel Ricca, a Harvard Business School graduate who previously built and scaled a Y Combinator-backed startup. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to drive high-ownership execution across frontend and backend and to help shape the platform’s technical foundation. You will make architectural contributions, deliver complex features end-to-end from a technical standpoint, improve engineering workflows, and mentor teammates. This role is suited for someone who wants their technical scope to grow over time through demonstrated impact. Time commitment: This role is expected to consistently exceed 40 hours per week due to the scope of ownership, delivery urgency, and the expectation of demonstrable capability to grow responsibilities over time.
